title: Mrs. Nadia Marco

page_data.en:
WCT/
G. 90M 1-33

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. I, Special Branch
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY）
（批：Station, Date Oct. 18. 1939.）

Subject... Communication dated October 5, 1939 from the Netherlands
Consulate-General concerning Mrs. Nadia Marco.
Made by... D.C.I. Maklaevsky Forwarded by... C. G...

Mrs. Nadia Marco, alias Mrs. Feigen is a
Russian of Jewish origin who was born on October 18,
1898 at Goldingen, Latvia. She arrived in Shanghai
from Riga, Latvia in 1924 together with her husband
and son and shortly after her arrival she established
here a dress making salon.

In 1929 she divorced her husband and became
the mistress of Mr. Hotinsky, a well known broker and
cohabited with him for several years until he married
another lady.

In 1930 her ex-husband left Shanghai for
San Francisco, California, together with their son
where they both are residing at present.

Several years ago Mrs. Marco sold her dress
making salon to become a travelling representative
for several local large dress making establishments
and in the capacity of such, she visits various
principal cities in the Far East.

She is reported to be a hard working business
woman and there is nothing to report about her from the
moral or political point of view. There is nothing
detrimental in Police records to her character.

She took her maiden name of Marco after she
had divorced Mr. Feigen. Mrs. Agnes Marco, residing at
133 Route Say Zoong, Apartment 7, is her aunt.

D.C. (Special Branch)
（签名：B Maklaevsky - D.S.I.）

事由……荷兰总领事馆1939年10月5日关于纳迪娅·马尔科夫人（Mrs. Nadia Marco）的来函。
制作人……副督察长 马克拉耶夫斯基（Maklaevsky） 转呈人……C. G...

纳迪娅·马尔科夫人，又名费根夫人（Mrs. Feigen），系犹太裔俄国人，1898年10月18日出生于拉脱维亚戈尔丁根（Goldingen）。她于1924年与丈夫及儿子一同从拉脱维亚里加抵达上海，抵沪后不久便在此开设了一家时装沙龙。

1929年，她与丈夫离婚，成为知名经纪人霍廷斯基先生（Mr. Hotinsky）的情妇，并与他同居数年，直至他另娶他人。

1930年，她的前夫携其子离开上海前往美国加利福尼亚州旧金山，目前二人均居住于此。

数年前，马尔科夫人出售了她的时装沙龙，转而担任本地几家大型时装店的旅行代表，并以此身份走访远东各主要城市。

据报她是一位勤奋的女商人，从道德或政治角度而言，并无任何需报告之事。警方档案中亦无任何有损其品行之记录。

她在与费根先生离婚后恢复了婚前姓氏马尔科。居住在赛仲路（Route Say Zoong）133号7室的阿格尼丝·马尔科夫人（Mrs. Agnes Marco）是她的姑母/姨母。

副督察长（特科）
（签名：B 马克拉耶夫斯基 - 助理副督察长）

Consulaat-Generaal der Nederlanden voor Midden-China
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D.
Date
Tel. Adr: "Hollandia"
Telefoon : 80135/6
Shanghai, 5th October 1939.
9 Quai de France
No.3021.

Sir,
I have the honour to inform you that the authorities
of the Netherlands Indies at Batavia have requested me to
give some particulars about Mrs.Nadia Marco.
This lady who has been married before with Mr.A.Feigen,
at present residing with his son at 1500 Duarte, California,
U.S.A., paid a visit to the Netherlands Indies and returned
to Shanghai in March 1939. Her husband has received no news
from her for several months.
She seems to have been in correspondence with a Miss?
Agnes Marco, residing at 133 Route Say Zoong, Apartment 7,
and is stated to be of Latvian origine.
I should be greatly obliged to you if you would let me
know, if possible, whether anything is known against this
person from a political or moral point of view.
I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
Vice-Consul
for the Consul-General.

D.S.D. Nakalovsky
C. 5/10

To the Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch, Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特科登记室
编号 S. B. D.
日期
电报挂号：“Hollandia”
电话：80135/6
上海，1939年10月5日
法租界外滩9号
第3021号。

先生，
谨此奉告，荷属东印度当局在巴达维亚请求我提供有关纳迪娅·马尔科夫人的一些具体情况。
这位女士此前曾与A.费根先生结婚，费根先生目前与其子居住在美国加利福尼亚州杜阿尔特街1500号。她曾访问荷属东印度，并于1939年3月返回上海。其丈夫已数月未获其音讯。
她似乎与居住在赛仲路（Route Say Zoong）133号7室的阿格尼丝·马尔科小姐（Miss? Agnes Marco）有通信往来，据称其为拉脱维亚籍。
如蒙告知，从政治或道德角度是否掌握对此人不利的情况，本人将不胜感激。
谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
副总领事
代总领事。

D.S.D. 纳卡洛夫斯基（Nakalovsky）
C. 5/10

致：
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特科副督察长，
上海。

October 19 39.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge
receipt of your letter No. 3021 dated 5th
October, 1939, and in reply to inform you
that there is nothing in Municipal Police
records detrimental to the character of
Mrs. Nadia Marco. A copy of report is
forwarded for your information.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Deputy Commissioner
(Special Branch)

Consul-General for the Netherlands,
Shanghai.

1939年10月19日。

先生，

谨此确认收到您1939年10月5日第3021号来函，并回复如下：工部局警务处档案中并无任何有损纳迪娅·马尔科夫人品行之记录。现附上报告副本一份，供贵方参考。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

副督察长
（特科）

致：
荷兰驻上海总领事，
上海。
